snippet: INSIGHT: ECB President Christine Lagarde warns Europe risks missing its tokenization window without common rules, calling it “a huge opportunity” to build a genuine single digital asset market, as the global tokenized asset market hits €23B, five times its size a year ago.

title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
snippet: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.
